propositions: Rebar 0.12.0 minor release required version bump in lockstep across pyproject.toml, server.json (top-level and packages[].version), and uv.lock.

CHANGELOG.md required retitling of pre-curated [Unreleased] section to [0.12.0] - 2026-08-15, merging a pre-existing duplicate [Unreleased] header defect, and establishing fresh [Unreleased] and compare link footers.

Release process required preflight guards (version-lockstep, tests, lint, typecheck, build, twine check) followed by Gerrit review, submission to main, dispatch of release.yml with PyPI environment approval, and verification across PyPI, GitHub, MCP Registry, and Homebrew.

Post-publication acceptance required verification of PyPI serving, PEP 740 provenance attestation, GitHub tag/release with artifacts, MCP Registry listing, Homebrew formula sync, and channel install smoke test.
